description: Identify what a site is built with from its HTML and headers: CMS (WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Ghost...), framework (Next.js, Nuxt, Astro...), CDN/hosting (Cloudflare, Vercel, Netlify...), analytics, payments, support chat and web server. ~50 fingerprints; heuristic.
name: tech_detect
title: Detect a website's technology stack
